Hello, 

it may be helpful to check a few examples from your data (in your signal processing software), and get more sense about what could be the reasons causing the duplication. Is it the same feature being quantified for multiple times? Or are they indeed distinct features but for some reason assigned with an identical ID? It would then be easier to figure out how to fix your problem.

Best,
Tsung-Heng
